rankingRules.falseCutoff: by severity descending: gapSeconds = (true pause length) − (time the cut landed), i.e. how much of the pause the speaker still had left; ties broken by longer true pause, then earlier cut, then span key
rankingRules.missedEnd: by severity descending: gapSeconds = (model fire time) − timeout, with "never crossed the threshold at all" = Infinity ranked first (the model gave no signal, so the endpoint came only from the timer); ties broken by span key

gapDefinition.falseCutoff: gtEndMs − decisionEventMs, in seconds: how early the cut landed relative to when the speaker actually resumed
gapDefinition.missedEnd: modelFireMs − timeoutDeadlineMs, in seconds (Infinity when the model never fired)

reproduction.fullEvidence: RESULT.json (this directory) holds every error at every view, the courtesy-check record, the AC5 comparison and the AC7 evidence; ERROR-REPORT.md is the readable version

cutoff.agreement: bothModels = the two models fail on the SAME span; the one-model columns are the errors a model owns alone; baselineAlsoWithAModel = the timer already failed there too, so it is not evidence about the model

miss.agreement: bothModels = the two models fail on the SAME span; the one-model columns are the errors a model owns alone; baselineAlsoWithAModel = the timer already failed there too, so it is not evidence about the model

note: threshold 0 fires on the first cell of EVERY span (every p_eot ≥ 0), so this is the "never consult the model" timer baseline: it detects every EoT with zero latency and cuts every hold whose pause outlasts actionDelay. Identical for both models by construction — the model score cannot enter the verdict.

about: recomputed k/n from THIS run's own spans and scores vs the k/n P0.13 published for the same policy tuple (read out of P0.13's committed RESULT.json frontier, not typed in from prose)

items.note: P0.13 published only the per-view PARETO FRONTIER and this view has no frontier row at the operating point: the corpus-A view is degenerate (5 holds / 16 EoT) and a threshold-0.13 policy there is dominated by threshold 0.01 + actionDelay 0.5 + timeout 1. This run still reports its own numbers (below), but they are NOT compared against P0.13 and must not be read as a confirmed reproduction.

P0.13 published only the per-view PARETO FRONTIER and this view has no frontier row at the operating point: the corpus-A view is degenerate (5 holds / 16 EoT) and a threshold-0.13 policy there is dominated by threshold 0.01 + actionDelay 0.5 + timeout 1. This run still reports its own numbers (below), but they are NOT compared against P0.13 and must not be read as a confirmed reproduction.

grouping.groupingKey: speaker/session group carried on every span (manifest `group`)
grouping.note: This run's own fetch+extraction of the pinned parquet collapses the 1250 spans into 96 speaker/session groups; P0.13 published 96. Equal counts mean the same turns folded into the same groups, which is AC1's grouping check.

verdict: IDENTICAL on all 4 published model/view pairs (2 view(s) not published by P0.13 — reported, not compared); grouping matches (96 speaker/session groups)
note: Every published k, n and mean latency is reproduced exactly by an independent re-fetch and re-run — which is the evidence that this task's span set, cell geometry and score tables are the same objects P0.13 measured, not merely similar ones.

productionDiff.whyMergeBase: the worktree branched from develop; diffing the moving develop ref would show develop's OWN advance as if it were this task's change, so the merge-base is the honest baseline

untouchedPaths.note: the P0.13 python scripts were reused as BYTE-IDENTICAL COPIES in this directory (sha256-compared in reproduction.copiedP013Scripts) precisely so the P0.13 paths are never written to

noTrainingWeights.claim: no training/fine-tuning step exists in this task and no training-only weight was downloaded; the two ONNX files are inference graphs whose sha256 match the P0.13 pins, and the turn-1-mini repo's `.safetensors` (the torch/training-side artifact, pin recorded for reference) was deliberately NOT fetched — hf_hub_download was called for the ONNX file only

noPaidCalls.kind: public corpus/model/card fetches only; the two models run LOCALLY on CPU via onnxruntime
noPaidCalls.note: the only environment reads in this task's own scripts are SMART_TURN_MODEL (an optional local file path), HOME and HF_HOME (a cache dir) — no credential, token or API-key variable is read
